verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents an invoice editor with live preview and branding, and invoices can be emailed from Puzzle. Its AR aging report tracks unpaid invoices and matches likely payments, which partly covers seeing when invoices are paid. There is no evidence of online payment options on invoices or of tracking when an invoice is viewed. Missing for 10: online payment options (pay-by-card/ACH link) on invoices, invoice viewed/opened tracking, explicit per-invoice paid-status notifications, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: Puzzle's invoice editor lets you build a professional, branded invoice and see exactly how it will look as you go!
applies everywhere your invoice appears — the live preview, downloaded PDFs, and emails sent from Puzzle.
it shows what's overdue by customer, finds the payments that most likely pay your open invoices, and flags the receivables that need attention before you close the month.
